title: 第25章 周长老过往第26章 炼气五层
lines: 这日，又到了传授炼器的日子，李卓阳仍是早早的来到了炼器坊。
周长老仍是半躺在靠椅上，一副半醒不醒的样子。
但是李卓阳经过几次学习其实已经知晓，周长老在筑基境后期已经停留了近百年，目前寿元不多，所以便不愿多动。
“见过师祖！”李卓阳仍然是恭恭敬敬行礼。
“嗯！”周长老眼睛稍微睁开，浑浊的眼珠中，射出一丝精光。
“你修为已经到炼气四层顶峰了吧，这速度提升得不慢啊，为何卡在炼气三层会如此之久？”
“弟子也不知晓，只是感觉进入炼气四层后，似乎对天地间的灵气感受更亲和一些！”
“这是好事儿，炼器固然重要，修为也不能放下，尽快突破五层，若是你能在半年内突破到炼气六层，或许还能赶上一个大机缘。”
李卓阳听到，心中稍微有点诧异，但是周长老为人古怪，他不说，李卓阳倒也不敢问。
“弟子定会用心修炼。”
“今日，前两次你提炼的灵材，老夫都已经看过了，纯度不错，已经不需要我再指点什么，以后次数多了，纯度自然更高。”
前两次的传授，都是周长老先口述理论，然后便让李卓阳独自在锻造室练习。
因为提炼需要全神贯注，故而锻造室是有封禁法阵的，若无里面的人打开，外面是不会轻易开启的，所以李卓阳都能放心使用玄天宝鉴。
不过两次的提炼，李卓阳第一次只提纯到七成，第二次提纯到了将近九成，并非玄天宝鉴功能出了什么问题，是李卓阳不敢百分百提纯，否则那会太令人震惊的，宝鉴的秘密就有可能泄露。
而且按照周长老的传授，九成纯度的灵材，已经满足上品法器的锻造要求了。
“今日，老夫指导你来提炼一样特殊的灵材。”说着他朝李卓阳抛出了一团银黄色的东西。
“冰魄蚕丝？”这东西李卓阳一眼便认出来了，因为他手上目前还有几根。
只不过他手上的是已经经过提纯的，而这团看似是刚从冰蚕体内产出的一样。
“不错，这正是二阶妖兽冰蚕产出的冰魄蚕丝，今日，你需要将这些蚕丝，提炼至最高的纯度。”
“别怕地火不足，我已经将地火升级到最高温度，足够你提炼的，时间也不用着急，什么时候提炼完毕，什么时候出去。”
其实李卓阳在锻造室虽然也开启了地火炉，但是他一次也没用过。
“弟子遵命！”
周长老就是这种性格，他只吩咐任务，并不给多余的解释。
看着李卓阳走进了锻造室，周长老又眯上了眼睛，嘴巴喃喃说道：
“栋基，当年我若是早点把那内甲给你锻造出来，估计也不会出那档子事儿了。”
“你儿子的天赋比你还好，为师欠你的，便还给你的儿子吧。”
言毕，他满是皱纹的脸上，居然还多出了两行浑浊的眼泪。
这一幕，李卓阳自然看不到，此时他已经拿出了玄天宝鉴，开始了提纯。
这蚕丝，虽然不清楚周长老要拿来做什么法器，但是既然他今日已经让提炼到最高纯度，那李卓阳便计划待的时间长一点，把冰魄蚕丝给完全提纯。
这样也不太会引起怀疑。
蚕丝数量不少，饶是有玄天宝鉴的辅助，李卓阳也足足用了两个时辰才完成，他的神识也基本上消耗一空。
content_en:
On this day, it was the day to teach weapon refining again, and Li Zhuoyang came to the weapon refining workshop early.
Elder Zhou was still half-lying on the armchair, looking half-awake.
However, after several studies, Li Zhuoyang actually knew that Elder Zhou had been in the late stage of the Foundation Establishment Realm for nearly a hundred years. His lifespan was currently short, so he did not want to move too much.
"I've met Master!" Li Zhuoyang still saluted respectfully.
"Yeah!" Elder Zhou opened his eyes slightly, and a glimmer of light shot out of his cloudy eyes.
"Your cultivation has reached the peak of the fourth level of Qi Refining, right? The speed is increasing rapidly. Why are you stuck at the third level of Qi Refining for so long?"
"The disciple doesn't know either, but I just feel that after entering the fourth level of Qi Refining, I seem to feel more intimate with the spiritual energy between heaven and earth!"
"This is a good thing. Although weapon refining is important, you can't let go of your cultivation. Break through the fifth level as soon as possible. If you can break through to the sixth level of Qi refining within half a year, you may still catch a big opportunity."
Li Zhuoyang was a little surprised when he heard it, but Elder Zhou was a weird person, so Li Zhuoyang didn't dare to ask unless he told him.
"Disciples will definitely practice diligently."
"Today, I have already seen the spiritual materials you refined the first two times. The purity is good. I don't need any more guidance. The more times you refine it in the future, the purity will naturally be higher."
In the first two teachings, Elder Zhou first dictated the theory, and then asked Li Zhuoyang to practice alone in the forging room.
Because refining requires full concentration, there is a sealing circle in the forging room. If someone inside does not open it, it will not be easily opened outside, so Li Zhuoyang can use Xuantian Baojian with confidence.
However, in the two refinements, Li Zhuoyang only purified it to 70% for the first time, and nearly 90% for the second time. It was not that there was something wrong with the function of the Xuantian Baojian, but that Li Zhuoyang did not dare to purify it 100%, otherwise it would be too shocking, and the secret of the Baojian might be leaked.
And according to Elder Zhou's teachings, the 90% pure spiritual material has already met the forging requirements for high-grade magical weapons.
"Today, I will guide you in refining a special spiritual material." As he spoke, he threw a ball of silver-yellow stuff towards Li Zhuoyang.
"Ice soul silk?" Li Zhuoyang recognized this thing at a glance, because he still had a few strands on hand.
It's just that what he has in hand has been purified, and this ball looks like it has just been produced from the body of the ice silkworm.
"Yes, this is the ice soul silk produced by the second-order monster ice silkworm. Today, you need to refine these silks to the highest purity."
"Don't be afraid that the ground fire is insufficient. I have upgraded the ground fire to the highest temperature, which is enough for you to refine. There is no need to worry about time. When the refining is completed, you will go out."
In fact, although Li Zhuoyang also turned on the underground furnace in the forging room, he never used it once.
"Disciple, obey!"
Elder Zhou has this kind of character. He only gives instructions on tasks and does not give any unnecessary explanations.
Seeing Li Zhuoyang enter the forging room, Elder Zhou narrowed his eyes again and murmured:
"Dong Ji, if I had forged that inner armor for you earlier, I probably wouldn't have had such a problem."
"Your son's talent is better than yours. What I owe you as a teacher should be returned to your son."
After finishing speaking, there were actually two lines of muddy tears on his wrinkled face.
Li Zhuoyang naturally couldn't see this scene. At this time, he had already taken out the Xuantian Baojian and started purifying it.
Although it was unclear what magical weapon Elder Zhou wanted to use for this silk, since he had it refined to the highest purity today, Li Zhuoyang planned to stay longer to completely purify the Ice Soul Silk.
This is less likely to arouse suspicion.
There was a lot of silk, and even with the assistance of Xuantian Baojian, it took Li Zhuoyang two full hours to complete it, and his spiritual consciousness was basically exhausted.
title_en: Chapter 25 Elder Zhou’s Past Chapter 26 The Fifth Level of Qi Refining
